paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 这篇论文提出了结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（特别是半可分矩阵）在状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间建立理论联系 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵 [S3.SS3.p3]，并将线性注意力推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA）[S4.p1]，进而证明二者在特定情形下互为对偶 [S5.SS3.p1]。基于该框架，作者设计了新的 SSD 算法，其专用实现比 Mamba 的优化选择性扫描快 2-8 倍，并支持更大的循环状态 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。作者还据此设计了 Mamba-2 架构，在语言建模上保持与 Transformer 的竞争力 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在建立结构化 SSM 与注意力变体之间的丰富理论联系，从而将原本为 Transformer 开发的算法与系统优化迁移到 SSM 上 [S1.p2]。其动机在于 SSM 的发展与社区改进 Transformer 的努力相互脱节，导致 SSM 更难理解、实验，且难以像 Transformer 那样高效训练 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs
the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers from both an algorithmic and systems perspective.

method.text: 论文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（具有次二次参数和乘法复杂度的矩阵）这一抽象来连接 SSM 与注意力变体 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。核心思想是证明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵 [S3.SS3.p3]，从而将 SSM 的高效计算问题归约为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S3.SS4.p1]。论文还从张量收缩角度重新证明线性注意力，并将其推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA）[S4.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
the sequence transformation operator $\mathsf{SSM}$ ( Definition 2.2) coincides with the matrix construction operator $\mathsf{SSS}$ ( Definition 3.2)
it will allow us to reduce the problem of efficient computation of SSMs (and other sequence models) into efficient algorithms for structured matrix multiplication.
The main results in this section are a simple tensor-contraction-based proof of linear attention ( Proposition 4.1), and our generalized abstraction of structured masked attention in Definition 4.2.

experiments.text: 论文在合成召回任务和标准语言建模预训练及下游评估上对 Mamba-2 进行了实证评估 [S9.p1]。语言建模实验使用 Pile 数据集，模型规模从 125M 到 2.7B，遵循 GPT3 规格，并与 Mamba 使用相同的训练设置 [S9.SS2.p1]。下游零样本评估与 Pythia 等开源模型比较，这些模型使用相同的 tokenizer、数据集和 300B token 训练长度 [S9.SS2.SSS2.p1]。此外还进行了速度基准测试和架构设计消融 [S9.p1]。

evidence.quote: We empirically evaluate Mamba-2 on synthetic recall tasks that have been challenging for recurrent models ( Section 9.1), and standard language modeling pre-training and downstream evaluations ( Section 9.2).
The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
most importantly Pythia which were trained with the same tokenizer, dataset, and training length (300B tokens) as our models.
We validate that our SSD algorithm is much more efficient than Mamba-1 ( Section 9.3) and comparable to optimized attention for moderate sequence lengths.

findings.text: SSD 专用实现比 Mamba 的优化选择性扫描快 2-8 倍，同时允许更大的循环状态（8 倍于 Mamba 或更高，仅有极小减速）[S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。SSD 与优化后的 softmax 注意力（FlashAttention-2）相比具有高度竞争力，在序列长度 2K 处交叉，在 16K 处快 6 倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。在语言建模上，Mamba-2 在困惑度和墙钟时间上帕累托优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]，例如 2.7B 参数、在 Pile 上训练 300B token 的 Mamba-2 优于 Mamba-2.8B、Pythia-2.8B 甚至 Pythia-6.9B [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。SSD 与注意力层具有互补性，混合二者优于纯 Mamba-2 或 Transformer++ [S9.SS2.SSS3.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: A dedicated implementation of SSD is $2-8\times$ faster than the optimized selective scan implementation of Mamba
while simultaneously allowing for much larger recurrent state sizes ( $8\times$ the size of Mamba or even higher, with minimal slowdown)
crossing over at sequence length 2K and 6 $\times$ faster at sequence length 16K.
finding that it Pareto dominates Mamba and Transformer++ in both perplexity and wall-clock time.
Mamba-2 with 2.7B parameters trained on 300B tokens on the Pile outperforms Mamba-2.8B, Pythia-2.8B and even Pythia-6.9B
a mixture of SSD and attention layers outperforms the pure Mamba-2 or Transformer++ architecture.

limitations.text: 论文指出，Mamba-2 模型整体在短序列长度（如 2K）下训练效率可能不如 Transformer，因为相同参数量下 Transformer 有 L/2 个 MLP 层和 L/2 个注意力层，而 Mamba-2 有 L 个 SSD 层 [S9.SS3.p2]。作者还指出，可能存在其他矩阵分解方式能带来更适合特定场景的 SSD 算法，且半可分矩阵有丰富的文献和更多表示形式，或许能实现更高效的算法 [S6.SS3.SSS0.Px6.p4]。

evidence.quote: the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length (e.g. at $2K$)
a Transformer with $L$ layers would have $\frac{L}{2}$ MLP layers and $\frac{L}{2}$ attention layers, while a Mamba-2 model would have $L$ SSD layers
many other matrix decompositions are possible ... which may lead to more algorithms for SSDs that could be better for other specialized settings.
semiseparable matrices have a rich literature and many more representations besides the SSS form that we use
